name: baalda
title: Baalda
description: Manage your Baalda second brain from Raycast with note capture, search, folders, and AI tools.
author: owendavidprice

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.description: Capture a thought into your Baalda vault in seconds

commands.name: create-note
commands.title: Create Note
commands.description: Create a markdown note in a selected Baalda vault and folder

commands.name: manage-notes
commands.title: Manage Notes
commands.description: Open, edit, move, rename, append to or delete Baalda notes

commands.name: create-folder
commands.title: Create Folder
commands.description: Create a folder in a selected Baalda vault

commands.name: manage-folders
commands.title: Manage Folders
commands.description: Open, move, rename or delete Baalda folders

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.description: Search notes across your Baalda vaults

commands.name: browse-vault
commands.title: Browse Vault
commands.description: Browse vaults, folders and recent notes

tools.name: baalda-list-vaults
tools.title: List Baalda Vaults
tools.description: List the Baalda vaults you can access

tools.name: baalda-list-folders
tools.title: List Baalda Folders
tools.description: List folders in a Baalda vault, including paths and parents

tools.name: baalda-list-notes
tools.title: List Baalda Notes
tools.description: List notes in a Baalda vault, optionally within one folder

tools.name: baalda-search-notes
tools.title: Search Baalda Notes
tools.description: Semantic + keyword search across notes in your Baalda vaults

tools.name: baalda-read-note
tools.title: Read Baalda Note
tools.description: Read the full markdown content of a Baalda note

tools.name: baalda-create-note
tools.title: Create Baalda Note
tools.description: Create a new markdown note in a Baalda vault

tools.name: baalda-update-note
tools.title: Update Baalda Note
tools.description: Replace the full markdown content of a Baalda note

tools.name: baalda-append-to-note
tools.title: Append to Baalda Note
tools.description: Append markdown text to the end of an existing Baalda note

tools.name: baalda-edit-note
tools.title: Edit Baalda Note
tools.description: Make targeted edits to a Baalda note

tools.name: baalda-delete-note
tools.title: Delete Baalda Note
tools.description: Soft-delete a Baalda note while preserving its history

tools.name: baalda-create-folder
tools.title: Create Baalda Folder
tools.description: Create a folder in a Baalda vault

tools.name: baalda-delete-folder
tools.title: Delete Baalda Folder
tools.description: Delete a Baalda folder, optionally with its contents

tools.name: baalda-move-note
tools.title: Move Baalda Note
tools.description: Rename, move, or retitle a Baalda note

tools.name: baalda-move-folder
tools.title: Move Baalda Folder
tools.description: Rename or move a Baalda folder and its contents

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Baalda Server URL
preferences.description: URL of your Baalda server. Use https://api.baalda.com for the managed service, http://localhost:3010 for a local server, or your self-hosted URL.

preferences.name: mcpToken
preferences.title: MCP Token
preferences.description: Token from Baalda desktop app → Vault Settings → MCP → Create token. Starts with mcp_. The AI is bound by the same permissions as your account.

preferences.name: defaultVaultId
preferences.title: Default Vault ID (Optional)
preferences.description: Skip vault selection. Copy a vaultId from the Browse Vault command. If empty, the first accessible vault is used.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty to auto-pick first vault

preferences.name: captureFolder
preferences.title: Capture Folder (Optional)
preferences.description: Vault-relative folder for Quick Capture notes, e.g. Inbox. Leave empty for the vault root. The folder must already exist.
